name: Ontario Housing Supply Progress Tracker
known_limitations: Provincial progress tracking helps frame housing supply targets, but it does not by itself explain financing, project viability, site servicing, permit timelines, or submarket price dynamics.
notes: Phase 55B recheck confirmed the official tracker remains live and reports Ontario and 50-municipality progress for the 2024 target year. The page says its data were updated December 15, 2025 and are also available through the Ontario Data Catalogue; FTFN should not describe the tracker as a current 2025 or 2026 delivery measure until a later target year is posted.
